name: Mardant Strongoak
summary: In Aldrassil, Mardant Strongoak guides young night elves who take up the druid’s path. He teaches them to commune with nature and learn of the Emerald Dream.

sections.title: Instructor of the Wilds
sections.body:
Young night elves in Aldrassil who feel the call of the wild turn to Mardant Strongoak. He teaches new druids to open their senses to nature spirits, hear their murmurs, and channel healing magic.

Those beginning their work as protectors of the wild learn from him first. He introduces them to the mysteries and ancient perils of the Emerald Dream.

faq.answer: Mardant Strongoak trains night elf druids in Shadowglen, within Aldrassil. He guides new druids on Teldrassil in communion with nature and the first arts of spellcraft.

faq.q: What does he teach new druids?
faq.answer: Mardant Strongoak teaches new druids to understand wild spirits, cast simple spells such as Moonfire, and use healing magic. He also teaches them about the Emerald Dream.

faq.q: Where can I find Mardant Strongoak?
faq.answer: Mardant Strongoak can be found inside or near Aldrassil in Shadowglen, the starting vale for night elves on Teldrassil.
The Sigil is an instructional token given to young night elf druids in Shadowglen. It directs them to Mardant Strongoak for their early training.

angles.text: As a young night elf druid, you can look to Mardant Strongoak for your first lessons in the sacred duties of the Cenarion circle.
At the heart of Aldrassil, Mardant reflects the kaldorei devotion to living in harmony with Teldrassil’s growing ecosystem.
